department: Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering

deadline.value: International applicants apply by 1 February for Fall entry.

gre_subject.value: The program pages do not mention the GRE.

supervisor.value: Name a professor who agrees to supervise you when you apply; you must be accepted by a thesis supervisor to register.
supervisor.quote: To enroll, you need to have been accepted by a thesis supervisor. | The supervisor’s name is required at the time of application.

funding.value: Doctoral admits (including international) with an admission average of 8.0/10 (A-) or higher get an admission scholarship of at least CA$72,000 over four years; others rely on supervisor or other funding.
funding.quote: Have an admission average of 8.0/10 or higher. | This financial support offers a minimum value of $72,000 over a period of four (4) years

entry_route.value: Master's in chemical engineering (thesis or equivalent publications) with 75% (B+). Students already in the uOttawa master's can fast-track to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Hold a master’s degree in chemical engineering (with thesis or equivalent in terms of scholarly publications) with a minimum average of 75% (B+).
